items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: No, I never did play with Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Let's see, we were talking about the Chris Kelly band. Did you play with any other bands like that? Did you ever play with Buddy Petit? No, I never did play with Buddy Petit. How about Rene? Yeah. I played with Rene. When Rene? Well, I played with Rene and not regular. I mean, Rene used to play for Michelin Blunches on a Monday advertising for the, you know, for the store. Every Monday I used to play with Rene. Well, let's say he used to play a lot of high notes on his trumpet. He did. Well, how was that…

I was going to ask about some of the old times there, Nettis, when you first moved to the city. Did you hear people like Big Eye and Piku and... Yeah. Or was McCurdy around? Do you remember him? I heard of him, but I never heard of him play. I heard of McCurdy. I never heard of him play yet. Did you ever hear George Barquet? Was he hearing when you were in the bar?
